name: cykla-video
description: Cykla launch video: deterministic captures of the real app composed with Remotion, with procedural sound and an optional narrated cut.

scripts.preview: npm run sfx && remotion render CyklaTrailer out/preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28
scripts.render: npm run sfx && remotion render CyklaTrailer out/cykla-trailer.mp4 && remotion render CyklaTrailerNarrated out/cykla-trailer-narrated.mp4
scripts.render:sound: npm run sfx && remotion render CyklaTrailer out/cykla-trailer.mp4
scripts.render:narrated: npm run sfx && remotion render CyklaTrailerNarrated out/cykla-trailer-narrated.mp4
